title: Counterexample knowledge base for the WKB / Newton-polygon classification.
purpose: Catalogue strata of the moduli of irregular types where the naive forms of M1, N1, D2, S1, AT1, AT3, AT5, AT7 fail; used by the Phase-V counterexample_guard to tighten hypotheses before paper insertion.
scope_note: Counterexamples are drawn from Phase-III CTRL/MIX operators, Phase-II stress tests, Phase-IV consistency findings, and the Remark on Degenerate Loci in paper_draft.md.

strata.name: Discriminant locus of chi_w
strata.description: chi_w(w) has a repeated root, so |Roots(chi_w)| < r and at least one mu_q-orbit of C(L) carries multiplicity > 1.
strata.fix: Add hypothesis 'chi_w squarefree' (disc chi_w ne 0); resonance / logarithmic Stokes data appear when the discriminant degenerates.

strata.name: Equal-modulus locus
strata.description: Two distinct roots w_alpha, w_beta of chi_w share the same modulus |w_alpha| = |w_beta|; distinct mu_q-orbits collapse onto a single radius.
violates_naive_form_of: M1 Cor. (r concentric rings of size q)
strata.fix: Restrict to the open subset {|w_i| pairwise distinct}; on the equal-modulus stratum, replace 'rigid rotation' by 'rigid permutation up to shared rotation' (cf. Cor. 2 of Main Theorem).

strata.name: Zero-root locus
strata.description: alpha_r = 0 so chi_w has w = 0 as a root; c = 0 enters C(L) with multiplicity q and the dominant edge moves.
violates_naive_form_of: M1 (the edge is shared with a sub-edge)
AT1 (Delta_{0,j} = c_j has the same argument across j-pairs in a ring)
strata.fix: Add hypothesis 'alpha_r ne 0' (equivalently, chi_w(0) ne 0); when alpha_r = 0 the Newton polygon undergoes a wall-crossing and the dominant edge is replaced by a strictly shorter one.

strata.name: omega-resonance
strata.description: The angular differences arg(c_i) - arg(c_j) all lie in (2 pi Z)/m for some m > q; the cyclic symmetry C_m extends the Newton-polygon-forced C_q.
strata.fix: Either add 'no omega-resonance beyond mu_q' or replace 'distinct anti-Stokes directions' by 'distinct up to clustering at angular scale 2 pi / m'; for AT2 see Phase-IV calibration (universal-necessary; partial-sufficient).

strata.name: Inter-edge equal-radius collision
strata.description: A root w_alpha^{(i)} of chi_w^{(i)} and a root w_beta^{(j)} of chi_w^{(j)} on different Newton-polygon edges satisfy |w_alpha^{(i)}|^{1/q_i} = |w_beta^{(j)}|^{1/q_j}; rings from distinct edges coincide.
strata.fix: Restrict the per-edge factorisation Corollary to the open subset where the disjoint per-edge ring systems do not coincide radially; on the collision stratum the Stokes data interleave.

strata.name: Multi-edge zero-root sharing (M2)
strata.description: Adjacent edges E_alpha and E_{alpha+1} share zero roots at their joining vertex; in particular the right-most edge's zero-roots coincide with the next edge's leading coefficient.
strata.fix: Define per-edge constellations as multisets and identify the shared zero-roots at the joining vertices; the disjoint union is in the sheaf-theoretic / multiset sense.

strata.name: Coupled (non-block-diagonal) system
strata.description: A first-order system Phi whose leading symbol is NOT diagonalisable (or whose blocks are coupled at higher orders), e.g. a cyclic-vector reduction of a scalar irregular operator.
strata.fix: Restrict S1 / AT4 to genuinely block-diagonal systems; for coupled systems, S1 holds after diagonalising the leading symbol when its eigenvalues are distinct, with system-discriminant strata defining further degenerations.

strata.name: Z-resonance with large coefficients (D2 search-window limitation)
strata.description: A generic chi_w over a number field K may admit Q-linear relations among the c_k with coefficients exceeding the |n_k| <= 3, support <= 4 search bound used in Phase-III D2.
phase3_examples: (none detected in atlas, by construction; theoretical boundary)
strata.fix: State D2 (i) as 'no cross-ring Z-relation in the |n_k| <= 3 / support <= 4 search window'; the genuine algebraic-independence statement (no Z-relation at all) requires algebraic independence of {w_alpha^{1/q}} over Q and is a transcendental-degree statement going beyond the sweep.

strata.name: Cyclotomic sub-orbit relations for composite q (D2 nuance)
strata.description: For composite q, the cyclotomic field Q(zeta_q) contains nontrivial proper sub-cyclotomic Q(zeta_{q'}) with q' | q; these produce additional Z-linear relations within a single ring that are mu_q-forced but use sub-orbits.
strata.fix: Define 'mu_q-forced' as 'all per-ring sub-orbit sums vanish under the cyclotomic relations of mu_q' (this is the Phase-III refined definition); the cross-ring filter then identifies the truly cross-ring component.

strata.name: Nested-ramification cancellation
strata.description: chi_w(w) = chi_v(w^{q'}) for some q' > 1, but chi_v itself has structure (e.g. is constant or only one root), causing the effective ramification q*q' to be smaller than the apparent q*q'.
strata.fix: State N1 / AT3 with 'minimal q' such that chi_w(w) = chi_v(w^{q'}) admits no further inner factorisation'; iterate until stable.

strata.name: p-invariance at the discrete level (P1)
strata.description: For fixed q, varying p across coprime residues mod q produces operators with IDENTICAL constellation, Delta_ij modulus partition, and ring structure: P1 is TRUE at the constellation level.
violates_naive_form_of: NONE of the M1/N1/D2/S1 statements; this is itself a positive Phase-III invariance.
supports: AT7 as a *strengthening*: the analytic Stokes data DO see p even though discrete data do not.
strata.fix: P1 is preserved as a discrete invariance; AT7 records the analytic refinement that breaks p-invariance at the Stokes-data level.
